messages:
katie_r: Heads-up: OrionX asked about onboarding orionx-gt-30b:q6 for a Dedicated POC. asks: catalog entry, variant compatibility, EKM support, and a POC pricing estimate. can someone triage?

omar: who is the contact and what's the expected request pattern?

katie_r: contact is lindsey@orionx.ai. workload: high-concurrency chat with medium-length contexts (~2k tokens) + embedding calls for search. want low cost per token and good cache hit rates.

vince_ops: i'll run a quick compatibility scan against our a100-80 dedicated pool. kicking off now.

presales-bot: scan started: job=orionx_q6_scan_77. checks: kv-cache, kernel-compat, embedding-consistency. ETA ~5m.

ovar: (typo) 

vince_ops: scan results in. job=orionx_q6_scan_77. summary: kernel compatible, KV-cache efficiency slightly reduced (~+9% memory), embedding vector variance within acceptable range, no tokenization drift observed. report: https://s3.redwood.ai/presales/orionx_q6_scan_77/report.html

omar: good. any blockers for EKM?

sec-bot: security note: Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS. EKM workflows require an ops integration and a short validation window; some customers also want HSM attestations which we can coordinate under enterprise support.

vince_ops: ops impact: q6 runtime cuts compute cost ~15%, memory +9% from KV retention; if they want KV cache kept in fp16 we can lower memory but might slightly increase p99 latency.

katie_r: timeline for quote and ops sign-off?

omar: ops validation 1-2 business days if no infra work. quote by tomorrow EOD after I confirm memory sizing.

katie_r: thanks. i'll email lindsey with the scan link and tentative timelines. assigning follow-ups: vince = ops sizing, omar = pricing, sec-bot = finalize EKM text.

vince_ops: dropping a short repro prompt in case they want to test locally:

```
Prompt: "Summarize: \"OrionX user said: 'I'll sync later'\" — preserve nested punctuation and emojis \\ud83d\\ude09"
```

katie_r: perfect. closing until lindsey replies. :thumbsup:
